about_the_game:
Ghostly Acres is a cozy idle management game. This Demo encompasses most of the core features of the full game.

  • Turn an old house into a thriving inn for wayward spirits with the help of your friend, Flip the Ghost.

  • Furnish the inn to earn revenue from your ghostly guests.

  • Open up new areas for extra space, and clean up after guests.

  • Most importantly, collect all the money from the machines!

Story

Mel just inherited an old house from her Uncle. The house is amazing, but her Uncle still owes a lot of coins to the bank. Oh, and the house is haunted!

Mel was frightened at first, but the friendly old ghost Flip wasn't scary, just homeless. After hearing about the loan, Flip convinced Mel to open up her home to ghosts everywhere and create the first inn of its kind: Ghostly Acres, an inn for wayward spirits.

Furnish the Inn

Flip can build whatever you need. Buy and build beds + places to drink and eat to earn coins. Make sure you entertain your guests to really multiply your earnings. 

Manage the Inn

Mel needs your help to track down trash, clear new spaces in the inn, and to collect income from machines when they're full.

Pay Off the Loan

Don't forget why you went into business in the first place! You need to pay off your Uncle's loan from the bank. The good news is, as you pay off the loan you get access to new abilities like Upgrades and more.
